# ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io Daily Update (Feb 18, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw the introduction of a new pull request to add GNET by Galactica.com. An active issue regarding a memory leak in op-reth continued to be discussed, with further confirmation of its recurring nature.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

No completed work to report for this period.

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
A new pull request, [#1281](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1281), was opened to add GNET by Galactica.com.

## CLOSED ISSUES

No issues were closed during this period.

## NEW ISSUES

No new issues were reported during this period.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Memory Leak in op-reth
The issue [#19212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19212), concerning a memory leak in op-reth triggered by "The database read transaction has been open for too long" warnings, received an additional comment. The latest update from jonathanudd confirms that this issue is persistent and occurs repeatedly across all their nodes.
